notes: «سمعت رجلا، سأل جابرا» names an unnamed asker, who is not a link (rule 5); how Sufyan's route reaches Jabir's answer is not settled by the text
Jabir is the last link because his words («فقال جابر») are the saying (rule 6); occurrence 2, since the first «جابرا» is the object of the question
«فقلنا لسفيان» and Sufyan's explanation are his own words, not a second route
